commission_note_body: A commission on each online order is added to the subscription price: 11% on Basic, 9% on Online, 5% on Advanced and 1% on Professional Business. The rules for commission calculation, refunds and payment fees are specified separately in the plan terms.
faq_subtitle: A quick overview of the subscription and plan choice.
faq_q1: How does the free trial work?
faq_a1: The trial length depends on the plan: Basic — 3 days, Online — 3 days, Advanced — 7 days, Professional Business — 14 days. After it ends, billing for the selected subscription starts according to the checkout terms. The option to cancel the subscription and the trial terms are displayed before payment confirmation.
faq_q2: Can I change my plan later?
faq_a2: Yes. You will be able to switch to another plan. The recalculation rules and the effective date of changes depend on the subscription settings and payment terms.
faq_q3: How does the online order commission work?
faq_a3: Basic charges an 11% commission on online orders, Online — 9%, Advanced — 5%, Professional Business — 1%. Calculation rules, refunds and payment fees are defined separately.
faq_q4: What is included in the yearly Professional subscription?
faq_a4: The yearly option costs €2,099.99 per year and includes the same features as the monthly Professional Business. The saving compared to paying monthly is €299.89 per year.
faq_a5: After the trial period is successfully set up, the server stores the subscription status. Access to features should be determined by the server based on confirmed Stripe events, not just on the user reaching the success page.
